sloka: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणान् शरवृष्टिबिरर्दितान्।अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः ।। ६.७६.६४ ।।
transliteration: tāṁstu dṛṣṭvā harigaṇān śaravṛṣṭibirarditān।aṅgadaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhrātṛjaṁ plavageśvaraḥ ।। 6.76.64 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.
